name: Mish Designs Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2017, Mish Designs Ltd is in the business of providing ladies garments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) MDL processes fabrics into garments under the brand name MISH, CURVES BY MISH in India. 
b) It exports to the United Arab Emirates under the brand name ZOEY
c) The company offers a collection of over 1000 trendy designs under the categories of women's wear such as dresses, tops, co-ords, t-shirts, trousers and palazzos.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.96 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -3.47%
Company has a low return on equity of 9.97% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 203 days.
Working capital days have increased from 247 days to 349 days
